title: ExchangeSessionResponse
description: Source of truth: doorway operational session state (Operational, Category C). GET /auth/exchange-session exchanges a single-use transfer token for a full JWT session; reconstructed per request, never persisted as substrate truth. Rust wire authority: doorway/doorway-service/src/routes/auth_routes.rs ExchangeSessionResponse (validated by that crate's tests/schema_contract.rs).

humanId.description: Holochain human ID for the authenticated session

agentPubKey.description: Holochain agent public key for the authenticated session

identifier.description: Login identifier (e.g. email) of the authenticated human

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the JWT expires (the `exp` claim)

doorwayId.description: Doorway that issued this token (for federation). Absent when not configured (serde skip_serializing_if)

doorwayUrl.description: Doorway URL for cross-doorway validation. Absent when not configured (serde skip_serializing_if)

portalHostUrl.description: First reachable portal host URL for this human, when the human is a steward and at least one registered host responds to a health probe. Absent when not a steward or no host is reachable (serde skip_serializing_if)
